causes.label: Fuse is blown, or the circuit breaker tripped
remedies: Replace fuse or reset circuit breaker.
Remove any other appliances from the circuit.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Fuse is blown, or the circuit breaker tripped"

causes.label: Some of the sounds you’ll hear are normal
remedies: Soft food disposal shredding action.
Drain valve opening to pump water out.
Timer control as cycle progresses.
Detergent cup opening.
The motor stopping during the drying period.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Some of the sounds you’ll hear are normal"

symptoms.symptom: Water standing in the bottom of the tub

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: A small amount of clean water around the outlet on the tub bottom at the back of the tub keeps the water seal lubricated.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "This is normal"

symptoms.symptom: Water won’t pump out of the tub

causes.label: Drain is clogged
remedies: If you have an air gap, clean it.
Check to see if your kitchen sink is draining well.
If not, you may need a plumber.
If the dishwasher drains into a disposer, run disposer clear.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Drain is clogged"

causes.label: Correct detergent wasn’t used
remedies: Use only automatic dishwasher detergents to avoid sudsing.
Cascade®, Cascade® Complete and Electrasol® Automatic Dishwashing Detergents have been approved for use in all GE dishwashers.
To remove suds from the tub, open the dishwasher and let suds evaporate.
Add 1 gallon of cold water to the tub.
Close and latch the dishwasher.
Pump out water by slowly turning the Dial until a drain period is reached.
Repeat if necessary.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Correct detergent wasn’t used"

causes.label: Rinse agent was spilled
remedies: Always wipe up rinse agent spills immediately.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Rinse agent was spilled"

causes.label: Detergent with colorant was used
remedies: Some detergents contain colorant (pigment or dyes) that will discolor the tub interior with extended use.
Check the detergent cup for signs of any discoloration.
If cup is discolored, change to detergent without any colorant.
Cascade®, Cascade® Complete and Electrasol® Automatic Dishwashing Detergents have been approved for use in all GE dishwashers.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Detergent with colorant was used"

causes.label: Some tomato-based foods can stain
remedies: Use of the RINSE ONLY cycle (on some models) after adding the dish to the load can decrease the level of staining.
GE recommends Cascade ® Plastic Booster ™ to help remove these types of stains.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Some tomato-based foods can stain"

causes.label: Low inlet water temperature
remedies: Make sure inlet water temperature is correct.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Low inlet water temperature"

causes.label: Rinse agent dispenser is empty
remedies: Check the rinse agent dispenser.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Rinse agent dispenser is empty"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: Steam comes through the vent by the door latch during drying and when water is being pumped out.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "This is normal"

symptoms.symptom: Spots and filming on glasses and flatware

causes.label: Extremely hard water
remedies: Use Jet-Dry® or Cascade Rinse Aid® rinse agent to remove spots and prevent new film buildup.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Extremely hard water"

causes.label: Low inlet water temperature
remedies: To remove stubborn spots and pre-existing film from glassware: 1 Remove all metal utensils from the dishwasher.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Low inlet water temperature"

causes.label: Overloading the dishwasher
remedies: 2 Do not add detergent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Overloading the dishwasher"

causes.label: Improper loading
remedies: 3 Select the longest cycle.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Improper loading"

causes.label: Old or damp powder detergent
remedies: 4 Start the dishwasher and allow to run for 18 to 22 minutes.
Dishwasher will now be in the main wash.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Old or damp powder detergent"

causes.label: Rinse agent dispenser empty
remedies: 5 Open the door and pour 2 cups (500 ml) of white vinegar into the bottom of the dishwasher.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Rinse agent dispenser empty"

causes.label: Too little detergent
remedies: 6 Close the door and allow to complete the cycle.
If vinegar rinse doesn’t work: Repeat as above, except use 1/4 cup (60 ml) of citric acid crystals instead of vinegar.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Too little detergent"

causes.label: Combination of soft water and too much detergent
remedies: This is called etching and is permanent.
To prevent this from happening, use less detergent if you have soft water.
Wash glassware in the shortest cycle that will get them clean.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Combination of soft water and too much detergent"

symptoms.symptom: Yellow or brown film on tub

causes.label: Tea or coffee stains
remedies: Remove the stain by hand, using a solution of 1/2 cup bleach and 3 cups warm water.
WARNING Before cleaning interior, wait at least 20 minutes after a cycle for the heating element to cool down.
Failure to do so can result in burns.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Tea or coffee stains"

causes.label: Hard water minerals
remedies: GE recommends Jet-Dry® or Cascade Rinse Aid® to help remove some hard water mineral stains.
For extreme staining, clean the interior by applying automatic dishwashing detergent to a damp sponge.
Wear rubber gloves.
Do not use any type of cleanser other than those recommended or hand dishwashing detergent because it may cause foaming or sudsing.
Cascade®, Cascade Complete® and Electrasol® Dishwashing Detergents have been approved for use in all GE dishwashers.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Hard water minerals"

causes.label: Dial is not in the OFF position
remedies: Turn the Dial to OFF and slide the door latch to the left.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Dial is not in the OFF position"
